messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Update from Friday's work session
parts:
Hi all,

On Friday, Per joined me online and we worked on a number of updates:

The Renin website is now on GitHub and ready for pull requests:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-website

The package database is (packages.renjin.org) is also on GitHub now:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin-packages

We improved the search function and added a contribution form for packages developed exclusively for renjin and published to Maven Central, like Per's spreadsheet package.
https://packages.renjin.org/packages/contribute

We also prepared for the Renjin 3.5.0 release. All of the packages on our "must pass" list were passing (1 is now broken?). I hope we can do the final 3.5.0 release during our next working session, which I'd like to schedule for July 30th.

Renjin Working Session
Friday, July 30 · 15:00 – 19:00 (Amsterdam)
Google Meet joining info
Video call link: https://meet.google.com/iid-wsxn-qeb

Thanks again!

Alex

--
Alexander Bertram
Technical Director
BeDataDriven BV

messages.author: 42e5316f884713d9
messages.subject: Re: Update from Friday's work session
parts:
Thanks for hosting this Alex! I was very happy to see how close we are to a 3.5.0 release and deeply impressed with the speed you implemented new functionality (sometimes typing faster than I could think). 

I already did a PR for some minor updates of the website (which you already merged) and I plan to go though both the website and the documentation to see if there are things that could be further improved. I also started to work on a blog post on "collaborative analytics" that showcases the use of Renjin powered tools such as Ride and Munin.

Best regards,
Per
